title: Data Scientist & Analytics Lead
description: Seeking an experienced Data Scientist to transform raw multi-tenant data into predictive models and actionable strategic insights. You will partner with business executives and build statistical models.
responsibilities: Extract and clean large-scale datasets from Snowflake data warehouse using advanced SQL.
Develop statistical and machine learning predictive models using Python, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn.
Design and analyze A/B tests to validate business hypotheses and marketing strategy.
Create executive dashboards in Tableau or Power BI to communicate metrics.
requirements: Proficiency in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-Learn.
Experience with cloud data warehouses like Snowflake or BigQuery.
Demonstrated ability to convey complex quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong background in statistical analysis and A/B test experimentation.
